# v2.42-dev Release Notes

## Partner program "View students" now shows each person's actual training

A small follow-up to the roster fix in v2.41. When a requirement is satisfied by an
**alternative** (an "or …" training) or a differently-named variant, the people in
the **View** pop-up don't all hold the training named in the pop-up's title. The
list now makes that clear.

### Changed

- **New "Training" column in the View-students pop-up.** Each row now shows the
  specific training that person actually holds — which may be the primary
  requirement, one of its listed alternatives, or another catalogue variant of the
  same training. Previously every row implicitly appeared to hold the training named
  in the pop-up title, even when they qualified via an alternative.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- The counts and who appears in the list are unchanged from v2.41 — this only adds
  the per-person training detail.
